specs.title: Composable Server with Dynamic Component Loading

drifted.spec_text: using the create_component() entry point convention
expose the same gRPC interface as the existing certus-server
drifted.actual: service.rs has stub implementations returning empty results instead of delegating to IDispatcher

drifted.spec_text: verify interface compatibility at bind time
drifted.actual: Name-based binding with unsafe transmute; semantic name matching but no runtime type verification

conflicts: Spec says create_component() but implementation uses create_component_<name>() to avoid symbol conflicts
Spec describes external block-device/extent-manager dylibs but SPDK singleton requires them inside dispatcher dylib
